payout_quote: Medpace is seeking healthy adults age 18-55 to participate in a research study of an investigational medication. ... This study requires 1 outpatient screening visit, one 8-night consecutive stay at our Phase 1 unit in Cincinnati, OH, and 1 follow up phone call. Compensation for participation and travel up to $5,050. ... Study 111-106 | Version Date: 18-MAY-2026.
steps: Open the current Medpace study-participant flyer (study 111-106, version May 2026, Cincinnati, OH).
Call 513-366-3222 or visit the Medpace study-participants page to inquire.
Pass the eligibility requirements (healthy adults 18-55, BMI 18-32, non-smoker for 3 months, no Rx/OTC meds, pass urine drug and alcohol breath tests).
Complete the schedule: 1 outpatient screening visit, the 8-night consecutive stay, and the follow-up phone call.
Receive compensation for participation and travel up to $5,050.
catches: You must pass strict eligibility (no prescription meds, non-smoker 3 months, drug/alcohol screening) — not everyone qualifies.
The $5,050 is an 'up to' ceiling for participation and travel; it is not wages.
Time commitment: an 8-night consecutive inpatient stay at the Cincinnati Phase 1 unit plus screening.
You receive an investigational medication with real medical risks disclosed in informed consent.
biggest_catch: The $5,050 is a ceiling for completing an 8-night inpatient stay plus screening, passing a strict drug/alcohol and medication-free screening (not everyone qualifies), and receiving an investigational medication with real side-effect risks.
eligibility: Healthy adults 18-55; BMI 18-32; no Rx or OTC medications; non-smoker for at least 3 months; must pass urine drug and alcohol breath tests.
timing: Compensation for participation and travel in the study.
